response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) AS average_count, SUM(type_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.type_count, c.type_count::numeric / s.total_count AS share_of_total, c.type_count - s.average_count AS above_average_by FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS s WHERE c.type_count > s.average_count

assumptions.assumption: A type's count is its number of matched transaction records; a trader with multiple records contributes multiple times.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct traders who have at least one matched transaction record.
alternatives.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) AS average_count, SUM(type_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.type_count, c.type_count::numeric / s.total_count AS share_of_total, c.type_count - s.average_count AS above_average_by FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS s WHERE c.type_count > s.average_count
